findings.claim: The brief requires that the last real navigation click wins and that old creation completions do not affect new sessions. Neither holds. Send a first message from the New chat welcome, then really click another conversation, or open a fresh New chat, before bots:create resolves. When it resolves, selectComet(bot.id) runs without checking anything and pulls the view to the newly created conversation, away from the session the person picked last. The same failure reproduces on origin/next, and the file is outside allowedFiles. Only AppSidebar's navigation entry points could guard against it.
